content_zh:
“快点，在快点。”
幻境中，苏鸿章紧闭着双眼，不去看周围的树影婆娑。
“破！”苏鸿章一声怒喝，周围的幻影瞬间消散下一秒，苏鸿章便疾驰而出。
山洞外，苏鸿成宛如一座雕塑般静静地坐着，身旁是已经昏死过去的苏少卿。他的腹部血流如注，仿佛一朵盛开的血色花朵，在冰冷的地上绽放。
“苏鸿成！”苏鸿章怒发冲冠，声嘶力竭地吼着，如一头被激怒的雄狮般冲了出来。当他看到倒地不起的苏少卿时，提着剑便如疾风般冲了过去。
“二弟，你来迟了。”苏鸿成的身影如鬼魅般陡然消失，瞬间出现在不远处的树林中。
“你！他可是你的侄子啊！你怎么能如此狠心地下得去手！”苏鸿章紧紧地抱着苏少卿，那颤抖的手，如同风中残烛，而他那愤怒的指责，如同惊雷一般，在空中炸响。
"无毒不丈夫，二弟啊，这世界如狼似虎，利益，哼，才是至高无上的王道！"苏鸿成的目光如寒箭般冷冽，令苏鸿章如坠冰窖，不寒而栗。
“父亲说的果然没错，只可惜，我太笨。”苏鸿章封住苏少卿的经脉，让他不再流血，随后缓缓站起身。
“今日，我便替苏家，替整个风城，除了你这个祸害！”
说罢，苏鸿章便向着苏鸿成冲去。
“不自量力，就凭你。”苏鸿成戏谑的看着苏鸿章，随后一剑劈出，磅礴的剑气如同山一般直压而来。苏鸿章举剑相迎，但双方实力差距太大，他直接被震飞出去，口中喷出一口鲜血。然而，他并没有放弃，擦掉嘴角的血迹，再次冲了上去。一次又一次，苏鸿章不断地被击退，但他的眼神越发坚定。他深知，今日若不除掉苏鸿成，他日必定后患无穷。此时的苏鸿章，将生死置之度外，他心中只有一个信念——除掉苏鸿成。
“二弟，我真不知道是该夸你坚定还是该骂你傻了。”
苏鸿成一掌拍在苏鸿章背后，苏鸿章登时便飞了出去。
“噗。”
苏鸿章倒在地上，脸色苍白如纸，嘴唇紧闭，额头青筋凸起，似乎在与什么无形的力量抗争着。终于，那股压抑的力量如洪水决堤般爆发，他再也无法抑制，一口鲜血从口中喷涌而出。血液鲜红而刺眼，顺着他的嘴角流淌下来，形成一道触目惊心的红线。
“二弟，你应该知道，我的目的只有少卿，如今我的目的已经达成，我不想杀你，你不要逼我。”苏鸿成冷道。
“到了今天，不管是为了少卿，还是为了苏家，我们之间，都必须有一个了断。”
苏鸿章缓缓站起身，手中还拿着一个木盒。
“偷天丹，那老东西还真是舍得，不过少卿已经被我废了，你确定还要这么做，搭上一个自己，你想清楚了吗。”苏鸿成笑道。

苏鸿章没有说话，他对于这个无情无义的大哥已经无话可说。
“苏家的未来没了，但我不能让你在祸害苏家。”
苏鸿章打开木盒，只见里面放着一枚丹药，他没有犹豫，拿起丹药仰头吃了下去。
下一秒，苏鸿章的气势一路暴涨，修为竟然在不断攀升。
“都是疯子，偷天丹一旦吃下去，一炷香时间内，修为提升五个段位，但代价，轻则修为不能再有寸进，重则性命难保，弟弟啊，你狠起来，和我也差不了多少啊。”苏鸿成仍是一脸的平淡。
“苏鸿成，如今我已玄关九段，今日，便是你的死期！”苏鸿章怒喝着冲向苏鸿成。
二人顿时开始激战，苏鸿章虽修为暂时高于他，但苏鸿成的战斗经验远高于苏鸿章，一时间也难以分出胜负。
突然苏鸿成一个不注意露出破绽，苏鸿章瞬间抓住机会。
“破风剑诀！”
一道剑气划过，苏鸿成急忙躲避。
刺啦！
content_en:
"Hurry up, hurry up."
In the illusion, Su Hongzhang closed his eyes tightly and did not look at the dancing shadows of the trees around him.
"Broken!" Su Hongzhang shouted angrily, and the surrounding phantoms instantly dissipated for a second, and Su Hongzhang galloped out.
Outside the cave, Su Hongcheng sat quietly like a sculpture, with Su Shaoqing beside him who had passed out. His abdomen was bleeding profusely, like a bloody flower blooming on the cold ground.
"Su Hongcheng!" Su Hongzhang was furious, roaring at the top of his lungs, and rushed out like an enraged lion. When he saw Su Shaoqing lying on the ground, he rushed over like a gust of wind with his sword in hand.
"Second brother, you're late." Su Hongcheng's figure suddenly disappeared like a ghost, and instantly appeared in the woods not far away.
"You! He is your nephew! How could you be so cruel to kill him!" Su Hongzhang hugged Su Shaoqing tightly. His trembling hands were like candles in the wind, and his angry accusations were like thunder, exploding in the air.
"No poison, no husband, second brother, this world is like a wolf and a tiger, profit, hum, is the supreme king!" Su Hongcheng's eyes were as cold as cold arrows, making Su Hongzhang tremble as if he had fallen into an ice cellar.
"Father is indeed right, but it's a pity that I'm too stupid." Su Hongzhang sealed Su Shaoqing's meridians to stop his bleeding, and then slowly stood up.
"Today, on behalf of the Su family and the entire Fengcheng, I will rid you of this scourge!"
After saying that, Su Hongzhang rushed towards Su Hongcheng.
"Don't overestimate your ability, it's up to you." Su Hongcheng looked at Su Hongzhang teasingly, and then slashed out with his sword, and the majestic sword energy came straight towards him like a mountain. Su Hongzhang raised his sword to meet him, but the strength gap between the two sides was too great. He was directly knocked away and a mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth. However, he did not give up, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and rushed forward again. Time and time again, Su Hongzhang was constantly repelled, but his eyes became more determined. He knew very well that if Su Hongcheng was not eliminated today, there would be endless troubles in the future. At this time, Su Hongzhang put life and death aside, and he only had one belief in his heart - to get rid of Su Hongcheng.
"Second brother, I really don't know whether I should praise you for being firm or scold you for being stupid."
Su Hongcheng slapped Su Hongzhang on the back, and Su Hongzhang flew out immediately.
"Pfft."
Su Hongzhang fell to the ground, his face was as pale as paper, his lips were tightly closed, and the veins on his forehead were bulging, as if he was fighting against some invisible force. Finally, the suppressed power burst out like a flood. He could no longer suppress it, and a mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth. The blood was bright red and dazzling, flowing down the corner of his mouth, forming a shocking red line.
"Second brother, you should know that my goal is only Shaoqing. Now that my goal has been achieved, I don't want to kill you, so don't force me." Su Hongcheng said coldly.
"Today, whether it's for Shaoqing or the Su family, there must be an end between us."
Su Hongzhang stood up slowly, holding a wooden box in his hand.
"Stealing the Heaven Pill, that old guy is really willing to give up, but Shaoqing has been crippled by me. Are you sure you want to do this and hook up with me? Have you thought clearly?" Su Hongcheng said with a smile.
Su Hongzhang didn't speak. He had nothing to say to this ruthless and unjust brother.
"The future of the Su family is gone, but I can't let you harm the Su family."
Su Hongzhang opened the wooden box and saw a pill inside. Without hesitation, he picked up the pill and ate it.
The next second, Su Hongzhang's momentum skyrocketed, and his cultivation level continued to rise.
"They are all lunatics. Once you eat the Heaven Stealing Pill, your cultivation level will increase by five ranks within one stick of incense. However, the price ranges from not being able to improve your cultivation level any further, to the worst case, your life. Brother, if you are ruthless, you will not be much different from me." Su Hongcheng still looked calm.
"Su Hongcheng, now I have reached the ninth level of Xuan Guan.Day is your death day! "Su Hongzhang shouted angrily and rushed towards Su Hongcheng.
The two immediately started fighting fiercely. Although Su Hongzhang was temporarily higher than him in cultivation, Su Hongcheng's combat experience was much higher than Su Hongzhang's, and it was difficult to tell the winner for a while.
Suddenly Su Hongcheng accidentally revealed a flaw, and Su Hongzhang immediately seized the opportunity.
"Breaking Wind Sword Technique! "
A sword energy passed by, and Su Hongcheng hurriedly avoided it.
Stab!
